# Quaternius Samples

- Author: Quaternius.
- Farmer.gltf: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularcharacters.html
- Horse.gltf: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal. The original notices are retained as characters-License.txt and animals-License.txt. Both official pack pages were checked on 2026-10-13.
- These source files contain embedded buffers. The Blender importer preserves the source animation clip names, records per-clip bounds and exports farmer-v3.glb and horse-v3.glb with author/license metadata.
- Editable imported Blender files are stored in source/elements. These samples are not original project-authored geometry, and their inclusion does not add new independent terrain families.
